Kavya Rao: Pulling together the runtime Q&A follow-ups from today. Keeping this short & actionable.
Zoe Wang: Can you confirm the p95 SLA numbers and the measurement profile? Some of our tests used 4k context.
Kavya Rao: Hosted p95 = 120ms, Dedicated committed p95 = 100ms. Measured at 8k context steady-state, avg request ~512 tokens, default quantized path.
Marcus Holt: Does 'steady-state' mean warmed KV cache? Our cold runs are ~2x worse.
Kavya Rao: Yes; steady-state implies warmed caches. We'll publish separate cold-start baselines in the perf doc.
Ivy Zhou: Batching: will latency_budget_ms be adjustable per-route? We saw tail regressions when dynamic batching was enabled company-wide.
Kavya Rao: Yes. Default is latency-first (stop on latency_budget_ms or max_batch_size). Per-route override can opt into throughput-first batching. Aggressive dynamic batching will be behind a canary flag.
Zoe Wang: Please drop a minimal config snippet so infra teams can mirror locally.
Kavya Rao: Will post a YAML example here by EOD.
sre-oncall: KV eviction follow-up: a tenant hit tail latencies when the global pressure eviction kicked. Any immediate mitigations?
Marcus Holt: Short-term: bump tenant-specific TTLs and reduce pressure threshold. Long-term: switch to per-tenant LRU with a protected recent-prefix segment. Engineering to publish eviction algorithm + metrics to watch.
Ivy Zhou: Tracing request: can we get per-kernel spans (matmul/softmax/attention) surfaced in Console traces? Current traces lump everything.
Kavya Rao: Runtime will add kernel-level spans (kernel_name, kernel_ms, kernel_device) behind a feature flag next sprint.
Zoe Wang: Hotpatch safety: we had a partial hotpatch that left some requests hung. Who should I ping with trace ids?
Kavya Rao: Tag SRE+Runtime here and drop trace ids. We'll triage ASAP.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: runtime/kernel-aot-proto -> canary group epsilon (job 10121) :rocket:
Kavya Rao: Actions recap: Zoe to run local tests with YAML; Marcus to coordinate TTL tweak for affected tenant; Runtime to publish eviction doc + add kernel spans; SRE+Runtime to investigate hang traces. I'll post the rollout checklist tonight. Ping me for blockers.
